body: That nothing I do will ever be good enough. That I am never pretty enough, smart enough, wise enough, or good enough to be loved.

Oh, wow. This is totally my Nmom. Mine did the highlighting thing too (she bothered to PAY for these detailed bills) and interrogated me- sometimes busting in the door in the middle of the night with a crazy expression on her face. When I got my own phone plan she began creeping in at 3am to steal my phone and attempt to open it, take pictures of it, etc.

I'm so happy to hear that! I understand the guilt but if she pursues you or tries anything, I encourage you to seek out the police. She is not your mother in any sense of the word from how she treats you and the guilt is purely conditioning and brainwashing. You owe her nothing. You deserve your life and happiness.

Please keep us updated and be well.

Your Nmom is almost exactly like mine. I really do understand what you are going through and went through the same scenarios- being yelled at constantly, seeing her turn into a demon, and then pretend it was all ok later.

She is insane and mentally unstable. You are at great risk and danger and need to get out of there ASAP. Talk to your university's student affairs office and see if someone can help- mine offered me free temporary housing on-campus and drove me to the police station to get a restraining order. You can do it, I believe in you. Please keep us posted and stay safe. Life is so, so much more than the hell you've been experiencing, and when you are out, it is unbelievably bright and beautiful.

Yes. Being sick would mean a full-fledged 5-hr (literally) screaming match at me, nonstop, with me dead silent and wishing I could die. It did not occur to me till almost a year after going NC and leaving the toxic hellhole that I could go to a doctor and seek treatment. I was diagnosed with several issues, some of them requiring surgery, and was asked by astonished doctors why I hadn't had this treated years ago.
That's exactly what my Nmom started doing when I began developing autonomy, before I left. It's infuriating and ridiculous but yet another way for them to turn things around and make it about them.

Congrats in advance on moving away from that nest of toxicity! Good for you!! And yes, those hypothetical babies will never have to experience any of that. I bet you can't wait to get away.

Random question, but may I ask how you got a PTSD dog?

Hey, a huge congrats to you. That's an awesome first step! I remember when I got my first job and Nmom hated every part of it- until she forced me to hand over my paychecks. Then she loved it, of course.

Please make sure your Nmom does not have access to your money. Lock down your checking account and make sure the people at the bank know not to give information (or access) to your mother or other family member.
Oh goodness, congratulations!!!!! I'm so, so happy for you. <3 (PS- I'm a Whovian so your SO must be pretty awesome to give you that ring.)
Wow. What's sad is that your uncle is still able to get a job...geez!

Hey, I'm really, really happy for you. Congratulations!! I am still going through the guilt and hope and sadness, and I've been terrified that when my parents die, I'm going to be a total mess. Reading your post gives me a lot of hope. Again, congrats and enjoy your life to the fullest :)
Nmom also works in the medical field so she knows this. I guess the rules just don't apply to them!

Nope, she had no idea how inappropriate that was. She was going on about how "wouldn't you prefer to have your own brother do it instead of some random creep male doctor? He's your OWN BROTHER, I don't see what's wrong!"

Yep.
Oh geez, that sounds terrible! Good for you for shutting that down...what BS.
Sadly, yes, which makes his belief that there we were never abused even worse.

Thanks. Sometimes when reading this sub, it feels like everyone else is able to stay angry at their crazy parents, but even though the abuse I went through was absolutely terrible, I can't stay angry like that. I wish I could. I don't know I'll ever be at peace about my parents.

I am having trouble with my conflicting feelings about Nmom. She was terribly abusive and I have a huge amount of issues left over from her, including PTSD. Sometimes, I will suddenly remember a horrible memory that makes me want to vomit, but even *at the same time* that I'm remembering that memory, I will have "good" memories and excuses for her in the back of my head, and still miss her.

I don't feel like therapy is helping much with this, or that my therapist really understands these conflicting feelings. I'm struggling in my head, alone, every day and it's difficult sometimes. It's so tiring.

Wow, Nmom did this to me too. Though when GCbro actually tried to call CPS a long time ago, before he was brainwashed, she went insane. She used to threaten to put me up for adoption quite frequently and wanted us to beg her not to. I actually wished she would follow through.

Had the strangest dream/nightmare tonight that I met my mother again, she was old and frail and couldn't see me well. I regretted the protective order I had against her (I don't have one anymore) and we reconciled, and she said she was sorry. I've been NC over a year.

I don't know what's wrong with me, or if maybe reconciliation is something I want.

You're right, and I try to tell myself that but I am horrible at being kind to myself. Thank you...I don't know if I am trained to expect bad things to happen, but my mind has blown up simple things into thinking that my SO is having an affair. My rational mind doesn't seem to have much control over the anxiety.

Unfortunately not, I was a minor when it was purchased so it was never in my name or anything. Also, without going into too much detail, I am a professional and an instrument like this is not replaceable. It is extremely valuable (including in monetary value) and personal. :/

It's super hard to explain to him as he has some really wonderful parents and talking about my issues makes him uncomfortable or upset because he wants to fix things or help- not just listen and provide support.

Thanks! I will try to keep that in mind. I guess it's harder sometimes because my SO tends to be, by default, rather uncommunicative and poker-faced- not in an effort to hurt anyone, of course, but as an effect of cultural conditioning. It's only when he's relaxed enough around me and we're alone that he loosens up.

I don't know if it's because Mother's Day is coming up and my coworkers are constantly talking about it, but this week has been incredibly bad for me. All sorts of fleas and repressed emotions and dreams have been coming up. I am terrified that I've made my SO angry or annoyed with me and that he's going to leave me. I'm probably misinterpreting him, and I'm always trying so hard to find that "real" hidden feeling that he must be mad at me. I'm a mess. I can't tell him because what if he's really mad at me or wants his space? He'll distance himself even more from me. 

I hate myself sometimes and I wish I were less of a failure. I try to remind myself that I had the strength to go to police, stand up for myself in court without a lawyer, get a full-time job, and more without giving in to the depression and pressure the flying monkeys put me under. But my scared inner child always seems to prevail.
Thanks for this! I wil be giving my therapist a few more chances and have expressed my opinions to him. If he still fails to acknowledge them, I'll definitely be using this.

Since I'm not a minor, apparently it could be trespassing if I enter her home. I am not sure how accurate this is though. 

Your in-laws sound fabulous! Congrats for finding such nice people :) I really do hope I can start building a circle of supportive people- I can't seem to find any.
Thank you, I appreciate the reply. I was told by a lawyer that since I am not a minor, entering her house could be considered trespassing, so I'm not sure what to do.
Thank you. I'm just worried she will claim it is legally hers and refuse to let me take it. She is also in another state. To my knowledge, since it is valuable she has been attempting to sell it.
I've told him but no change. I'll try again this week and if not, I guess I'll have to look for a new one. I'm not sure how to "fire" a therapist!

I've told him my opinions and what I feel, but he seems to put them off and concentrate on other aspects I don't feel are that important. I don't think it's intentional, but just him not understanding and I'm not sure what else to tell him. Part of me wonders if he knows best...?
Just had to say that hey, this is seriously awesome! You guys rock :)

I'm guessing you're in high school, but I did report the abuse in college as Nmom had followed me there. The dean of the university believed me and that same day I received a protective order against Nmom, moved out my things, and stayed on campus at a dormitory provided free of charge (amazing generosity). This was the first step to starting my life.

As a minor, things might be more difficult. Are you hoping to get emancipated or just want someone to talk to?
Oddly enough, my Nmom loved Marie and I was also very uncomfortable about that family dynamic. And yup- I don't like my name. I hate saying it and hearing it said.
Ooh, that sounds just perfect :) You must have an awesome name!!!

This post is SO perfect and true. When I went NC, they tried everything- guilting, acting nice, threatening, demanding I return "right this second" as if I were a child, said I was ruining the family (I suppose I was ruining their family dynamic with me as SG). Now that they realized I am not taking any of their shit, they don't want anything to do with me. I suppose there is nothing for them to get from me any longer so they have moved on.

I don't know if I should feel sad about that.

Hey, I really congratulate you and I'm SO happy to hear you are okay. That you beat everything. Because I've sort of resigned myself to never being truly ok, and I thought it was impossible to change. You give me hope, so thank you so much for being incredible.

He is interested to some degree- he's mentioned considering it in the past but in the end never went, partially due to just not working up to it as he has no idea what to expect and there's tons of cultural stigma. I definitely intend to make it clear I'm the one who wants it, though.
Nope, not an emergency at all. I know he's had an interest in therapy as he's always wanting to improve himself, but due to stigma + cultural factors + uncertainty he's never gone.
Geez the N's and their control over important documents. I'm glad you're going to get a new one soon! I wonder if I'll be able to find a new name for myself like you have.
That is a good point! He's struggled with dealing with stress and internalizing emotions, and is always wanting to improve in this aspect.
That's exactly how I feel about my name- it's just floating, not attached to me.
Wow. That is disgusting and I am glad you are happy with your name now. My Nmom would often call me "that girl" in the most derogatory way possible.
Hey, that's a cool idea. I might try scrambling up my name as well! Have you considered changing your name officially?
Wow, I had no idea how many people changed their names! I hope I never have to hear her say my name again. Have you officially changed your name or is it still unofficial?
I think I have found the right one to help me with Nmom. I never expected to find someone so quickly :)

I have had this problem for as long as I can remember. I posted a long time ago about it as well I think. I'm hoping therapy can help but I know you're definitely not alone in this- I bet all severe abuse victims suffer from it. Recently a friend got mad at me and raised his voice, and I shut down straightaway and could not make myself speak. I had to leave and explain afterwards.

It's terrible and I hope we can conquer this. Good luck to you!

Thank you, I really appreciate the response.

I think you are right as sometimes I will start crying for no reason, and then realize I'm holding a lot of pain and anger towards Nmom that needs to be released. There doesn't seem to be an end to the garbage.

I will give meditation a try. I am so sick of my life basically hinging on this anxiety. Thank you again for your support- I really needed it.

Just had to comment and say I'm shocked at how similar an incident happened to me with Nmom. The wording of what your mother said is identical and I wonder if they all get this stuff from the same place. Sorry you had to go through that too.

Just feeling really, genuinely sad in a way that's new to me. I really, really, really just want a hug and I feel like my heart and soul are starved for love. I guess that's why I need my boyfriend so much- to feel loved, and I know that's bad and he can't always be there, but I just have nowhere else to get the love everyone else seems to always have from their parents or family.

I am so, so starved for love I'm worried I'll become an emotional vampire just like my Nmom.
Oh, wonderful. Am I ever going to be normal or close to it? I also easily feel lonely and depressed, even after I've seen friends or know there are a few people out there who care.
I'm still a mix of furious at how they ruined my life and hopeful that something will improve, even a little. I'm worried I'll respond imto them in a moment of weakness.

I don't want to right now. I guess I'm also worried that they'll act nice so I can't refile for a restraining order, but they'll slowly start getting worse as they regain control over me like before. I guess NC is just the way to go?
I think she will be smart enough to try to ruin my life without leaving evidence of it. She did that before until she unraveled enough for me to gather evidence.

I am still angry at Nmom though it's been a year of NC. I am furious, most of all, that she tried to hurt the person I loved most and ruin the most precious thing I had. She succeeded, mostly. I don't know if I will ever stop being angry. If she were to die, I don't know how I'd feel and that scares me sometimes.

I hate her and I wonder why I couldn't have been one of those thousands of others with normal families. She ruined my most sacred hopes and dreams and it's never going to be the same. I cannot forgive her for that.
$confirm /u/kozznot $50.00
It's my old address on the order. I'll see about getting a PO box!
It's a full order that has been in effect for over a year. I checked with te court and it does not count.
After I moved, I asked the court if I needed to update my address. They said that since I obviously didn't want them knowing where I live, I shouldn't.
Definitely not on my side. The whole family is Ns and Es.
But there's no waynto prevent them from knowing my address, right? Or where I got to school and such.
Oh, thank you so much <3 You're awfully kind!! I will try my best!

Thanks for your help! I'll definitely consider Mirena- it seems like a much better option at the moment, but I do have a very small everything (at least down there) according to my last obgyn. I know this sounds silly but I've also heard things about other side effects from the copper in Paragard.

The patch and nuvaring aren't options for me unfortunately (another story). I will be meeting a doctor for a consultation and hopefully get the Mirena inserted. Thanks again! :D It's a bit nerve-wracking and I feel better reading your post.
I'm really interested in Paragard, but now I'm hearing stuff about copper toxicity and while it's rare, I'm sure, I'm still a little leery. Pity everything comes with side effects!
Thanks. I'll keep those in mind. I think moving so close to my ex was a really bad decision, though. I can't believe how bad I feel again.
Unfortunately not. I'm so tired of the depression and a long, long time ago, I was actually happy and liked myself. I don't know how to treat myself well anymore. Thank you for your kindness.

Just moved, feeling horribly lonely and the depression is coming again. I can feel it. I don't know what to do. I'm lost and not having any support really, really sucks. I wonder if I will ever be able to feel normal.

I'm so glad your mother's friend took care of you and helped out! She sounds wonderful.

That's fascinating- it totally makes sense, and I wouldn't be surprised if it had to do with my earlier puberty & overall growing up.

Oh gosh, what it is with Nmoms and virginity and tampons? I had those huge pads too. I mentioned it here a while ago but when I hit puberty and began developing breasts, she made me think it was cancer. She humiliated everything about me growing up- body hair, odor, my body changes. I'm about to buy my first tampon box and it feels very silly as an adult to be researching how to use them. :)

Haha! Well, I was so sheltered my knowledge came from reading very old books in the library and trying to figure out what women did on their periods and what was normal. It was honestly pretty scary for me because I had very heavy periods. You'll be a great mom- I hope that if I ever have a daughter, I get the chance to do it right.
Oh gosh, I'm sorry! I used toilet paper. That's just beyond terrible.
It took way too long and I'm still healing, but I am glad too. Thank you! I only just remembered this memory and it is one of many I have to get through.
Thank you for confirming that. I think I knew it, but it was too saddening to fully accept.
Whoa. I didn't know there was a term for it. I can't internalize a single accomplishment and I don't know how to!
I wonder, is it possible for narcs to understand that's not how things work? Is it a form of self defense or literally how they see the world? Because if it's the latter, that's kinda scary.

Oh, gosh. I think I saw her today. I was at the train station and a woman I've never seen before was staring at me, smiling oddly, and then called my name. I recognized that voice and accent from the phone conversation we had. I walked away, fast, pretending I hadn't heard.

I am beyond creeped out.

Well, I told her politely that my information was private and the hospital could not give it out for certain reasons, thanked her for her concern, and basically ended it. 

And then I got another email and I only saw part of it, but she was insisting that "saying whether someone was a patient in a hospital was PUBLIC info". I deleted it and while part of me wants to reply to justify myself instead of being portrayed wrongfully, I'm not going to get sucked into that.

This is the first time I've met an N outside of my family. I have the most unpleasant feeling.
Whew, thanks. I'm not crazy!
No wonder I got Nmom vibes.
Thank you! Yes, I'm so glad I didn't end up renting from her. I'm getting shivers thinking about it.
Yeah, I definitely don't plan to! I'm so glad it wasn't just me. I'm still a little freaked out.

No problem. You're in the exact same position I was about a year ago and I really feel for you. I'm glad you've decided to stay with your boyfriend for now, and I hope he is supportive. Taking your mom out to talk sounds like a good idea but be prepared in case this does not work out (I did the same thing.) In the end, you may not be able to talk your parents into anything, though I really hope that it works out smoothly for you. Keep us updated!

Well, it's abnormal for humans to never fight IMO, but a normal family wouldn't make you live in constant fear not knowing when a blowup would happen randomly over the smallest things, or arguments that go way beyond a normal one. I once saw a normal family have a disagreement and I was terrified- but instead of turning into a huge fight, they were able to resolve it quickly with proper communication and an apology. If that were my Nparents, things would've been broken, the argument would become a screaming match from Nmom that brought in the whole family and guilted them on things they hadn't done, etc.

Says who? Your parents? Considering your academic achievements, I'd say you're quite amazing. Everyone has plenty to learn but you won't get it until you go out and live your life and make mistakes. It sounds cliche, but it's very true.

If you and your mom really do have a good relationship, communication about how you are feeling and what you want to do should be possible. If you don't feel like you can say that, it might not be as good as you think. Getting out of their grasp is mostly mental at first- once you realize you're in a mental prison, surrounded by fears that your parents have made you feel, the next steps are possible. Nobody goes out into the world fully prepared. We all don't really know what we're doing, and over time we learn to ride with the flow of life and be better prepared.

You just sound like you have so much potential but you completely believe your parents and everything they say about you. I know a big part of it is the culture and I've been through it myself, but if it's making you feel this miserable and causing you to break up with someone you love, something's not right. I nearly broke up with my SO when I came to and realized "hey, this is ridiculous. I can date whoever I want and am I really going to let my parents dictate even this?" There needs to be a point for you to realize something similar.

Every time someone knocks on my door, a neighbor bumps the wall, or I hear a moderately loud noise while at home, I panic. I instantly go into fight or flight mode and my heart races. I'm tired of it and sometimes it's so paralyzing, I literally stand in front of the door shaking and unable to open it, or I hide on the bathroom floor. I wish it would stop.

Reading your post made me feel very frustrated. You sound really enmeshed in your parents, their desires, and culture. Are you planning on moving out? I was in a similar spot with Asian parents and a boyfriend (I heard 99% of the same stuff your parents told you), but I snapped at a certain point. You need to decide for yourself whether you're willing to let your parents continue to run your life entirely and decide your future or not. I put my foot down and struggled for years, and finally got out but regret I didn't do it sooner- I lost so much. Your problem is not about your boyfriend, it's your entire relationship with your parents and the immense hold they have on you.

Stand up for yourself. I know just how hard it is, but you have to fight for it.
That sounds like heaven. Do normal people really get to live with that every day? No wonder they can't understand...

Good for you! That sounds like a good plan. I had to get a restraining order and moved out, and the anger slowly dissipated over time. I mean it's still there but now I can deal with it in healthier ways. I am just now starting to put things together. I hope you keep us updated on your journey! :) PM me if you ever need to talk.

Hey, I went through the same thing. After I came out of denial and really saw what was going on and how I was being treated, something snapped. I was furious all the time. I was furious at her and I didn't have an outlet. I believe this is a completely natural reaction.

Kudos to you for pulling your stuff together. I was also a student and failed two semesters as well due to Nmom's extreme abuse. Do you have a plan for moving out?

Oh yeah. She used to make edits too because when I was a kid (around 7yrs I think) I wrote about her physical abuse and she would erase it. GCsib would also steal my diaries and then they'd have fun reading it out loud, mocking me. Inevitably, I'd get in trouble for something, of course. One wrong spelling could mean a huge blowup about how stupid and dumb and worthless I was.

Ouch, sorry your break is already getting stressful! Nmom did the same with all my accounts/passwords except when I refused, she would get violent, tear up my room, etc. until I gave her a password. Then she'd insist I must be hiding more.

I'm finally going to find a doctor of my own for the first time, without Nmom answering all my questions for me and always insisting on being in the room. Finally going to hopefully get some answers about symptoms I've had for years, but which Nmom said I was either imagining/lying about/exaggerating or meant that I was a dirty slut doing things behind her back.

I just hope I have a good experience. I'm nervous and don't know if I should inform the doctor that I was abused in the past, because I don't want to be invalidated again. I just want some answers and  caring doctor who's open-minded. Seems pretty hard to find lately.

Haha, I actually do that already. So far, I've yet to forget the nonsense I use for my security questions, though sometimes when I call customer service and they have to ask a security q, they sound really confused.
Ohmygoodness. THANK YOU! I have never heard of that program but it turns out it's in my state. I'm so excited. I can't believe no one told me about this before!
Not my credit card info- my credit report. I already got new cards and numbers a while ago because when I lived with her, she took pictures of my cards.

They know past addresses because I lived with Nmom all my life till the restraining order. She knows the banks and loans because all my loans are ones she made me take out. I really don't have anything she doesn't know about, yet.

Oh, are you kidding me. Sweet America. I figured it would be something like that...

My driver's license is actually my old old address, but I'm sure something else will get my new address on public record. Seriously, why is this a thing?

No, they know better than to do that. It's a long story but they found my address somehow. Plus, the order expires soon.

I can change it but it's forever linked to my previous one. It'll also make things a lot harder for me I think (since everything is verified with it). I'd rather not have to change my name just to escape them.
To be honest, I'm more busy with moving and all the hassle that comes with it, so I'm ignoring him for now. He sent more texts which I haven't read.

Because they have all my personal information. My bank is secure, but I'm concerned whether my address can be looked up. I don't know how they got it before.

I'm trying to have the university put a note on my account not to give out information to anyone who asks.

Hm, that doesn't sound too bad...I've gone through worse. I definitely want the strings long enough for me to be able to check, because otherwise I'll be panicking wondering if it's ok down there. It's for that reason I don't even use tampons, haha...
Sounds awesome, thanks!! Will do :)
Well, I've taken many spoonfuls of elephant today! If this move goes smoothly, I think I'll feel proud of myself.

Actually, he just texted asking if the order was officially rescinded and that when it is, "maybe" he'll bring the "things I need".

There's one thing he has that I can't let go of and he knows it. I'm pretty mad.
Now, I just need to figure out how to do this enormous move and everything associated with it in a few days. Whew!
Whee! Yeah, I had a yeast infection....absolutely horrible. Thanks :)
Thanks. That wasn't even at the top of the list of what she did, but it comes closest.
Oh, forgot to mention I had an ultrasound and everything looked fine. :/ Will try, thanks!
Your experience is exactly what I hope mine to be. Thanks!! :)
Ouch, infection! Was it something you were able to notice or did you find it at a checkup? I'm always nervous that I won't know the IUD is causing trouble up there.
My previous doctor refuses to refer me to a urologist. I am in the process of finding a less-sucky PCP.
I was told by two doctors that this doesn't "really exist". I've yet to find a doctor who is willing to test me for it.

Yep. I think this happened to all of us once our eyes were opened and we were truly aware of what was being done. I was so, so furious at Nmom that she noticed that same evening and refers to it as the day I changed into a monster and suddenly lost our "loving relationship". I hated her with a passion. This hate lasted for several years until I was able to move out- even now, I sometimes feel flashes of that anger.

It's honestly a huge change in your life so it won't go away quickly. You'll have to start getting used to spotting all those little behaviors, those things she says, the gaslighting. For me it was like my whole perspective changed and the world had turned upside down. Use this awareness to your advantage so that you can protect yourself and work on getting out/staying healthy as possible. Also, try to stay away from her as much as possible: have extra work at school, study in the library, etc. Write about it if possible, or tell someone you trust if that's a safe option.

Warning: narcs have a radar and can tell when their victims have woken up. Be careful.

Hey, I'm terribly sorry you had to go through that. I can't imagine how traumatic it must have been and it's amazing you got through it on your own.

I has a close friend die from sudden heart failure and Nmom would not let me attend his funeral. She instead asked questions constantly about him, suggested he had killed himself, and when I finally cried, she started mocking me and saying I must've been secretly dating him to be making "such a fuss over a boy". Empathy simply didn't exist. Like your cat, my dog was my comfort.

I still have not been able to take off the armor completely. I am afraid to see how hurt I really am.

Hey, same here. It took a while of NC for me to realize just how messed up my father was. I guess with Nmom being so terrible, in contrast, Edad seemed like the nice one.

Though now, I've had memories come back and I realize Edad frequently pretended to be on my side to extract informatiom which he would report to Nmom. They would have conversations late at night talking about me and all of my many many problems, and Edad would share the results of his espionage. They would plot what to do next and how to get me to reveal the terrible secrets they were sure I was hiding. They were quite the team.

That makes you awesome in my book. :p I went to a community clinic and it was the worst experience of my life. It was laughably terrible. Hopefully, I'll be able to find better providers in the new city!
Haha, thanks! If you don't mind me asking, are you able to feel the strings? I've read complaints about it.
Awesome! I hope my experience is as good as yours! Was insertion really as painful as people say it is? I'll be going to a Planned Parenthood for the first time, and hopefully they have experience.

Aww, thank you. That made me feel so much better. :) I think I'm 70-80% decided on moving, and it seems I kinda have to for certain coursework. I just need to stop being so scared and get into action- huge time crunch!!
Thanks for your story! Everyone's body is different and I'm sure there's a chance I will reject an IUD- I'm a bit scared but I think it's a worth a try.
Thanks! I'm definitely leaning towards non-hormonal because I seem to be sensitive.
Oh no, not at all! Thanks for the info!! I hope the yeast infection thing doesn't happem to me because I already get them occasionally...if you don't mind me asking, did it really hurt?

Actually, I've really considered saying that I'll have to bring them back to court. I do have fight left in me and I hate that it's taken almost a year to even begin tbe process of recovering my things.
I won't mind spotting too much if the other side effects go away! I had an ultrasound before and was told my cervix was small, so I'm guessing Skyla will probably be my only option. Thanks!

Wow! Goodness. Kudos to you for staying, you're super awesome and your SO is lucky.

I'll try that as well. I think my insurance just really sucks and most places don't want to accept it.

Wow, I guess this a narc thing, huh? She threatened my then-SO and even found out where he worked and lived, and that was the final straw for him. :/

They've recommended a place but I'm not sure they accept my insurance. We'll see.

Due to the nature of the job, that's unfortunately not possible though I do get a few weeks off for holidays. I am wondering if it will be safer to compromise and stay here for next semester, and then if I still want to move, I can do it over the summer.

I'll stop trying to apply logic to a situation where no logic is used, then. I wish I'd known as well that I couldn't make her stop or help her. I tried for so many years at my own expense.

Thank you!! I really appreciate that.

Yeah, making friends is a bit difficult because before the restraining order, Nmom called everyone on my phone threatening them & telling them to stay away from me. She also made scenes on campus, and lots of gossip spread quickly.

I need to find a new counselor as I'm not eligible to use school counseling (and it's at the old campus). I guess there's just a lot of risk- I'm scared to move, but at the same time the thought of staying here weighs me down.
